failures: Multilingual family did not improve: ftspeech

bootstrap.method: Paired multinomial bootstrap of all source-qualified global clusters; identical draws for both models and all metrics
bootstrap.unit: speaker; FLEURS parallel sentence identity shared across languages
bootstrap.scope: Fixed declared languages and corpora, not a random sample of all languages
bootstrap.empty_draw_handling: Only undefined metric replicates are omitted; report count and suppress interval if fewer than 80% remain

limitations: FLEURS sentence clusters are not speaker clusters
CV uses inherited truncated speaker hashes
RixVox protocols are not always verbatim
Repeated English Dialects prompts are present; novel-prompt results are diagnostic
Per-accent intervals are descriptive, without simultaneous multiple-comparison guarantees
